task.instruction: Identify a course or Specialization on Coursera that helps business process management with with a rating 4.7.

final_answer:
On Coursera, the course that matches is **Business Process Modelling** by **STARWEAVER** (instructor Igor Arkhipov), rated **4.7 stars from 135 reviews**.

Details: Beginner level, 1 module (~9 hours to complete), 14,118 already enrolled, taught in English with 3 languages available, includes 4 assignments and a shareable certificate. It covers identifying and scoping business processes, analyzing process logic for efficiency, and choosing suitable modeling notations — BPMN, UML, flowcharts, DFD, and eEPC — to document and communicate operations clearly. Skills gained include Business Process Management, Process Modeling, Workflow Analysis, Business Analysis, and Process Improvement.

Link: https://www.coursera.org/learn/business-process-modelling

If you specifically want a Specialization rather than a single course, the closest match at that rating tier is a different product — let me know and I can look for a 4.7-rated Specialization in this area too (the ones surfaced in search were Project & Process Management for a Tech-Driven Workplace, which didn't show a 4.7 rating).

judge.rationale: The Coursera page shows “Business Process Modelling” with skill Business Process Management and a 4.7 rating; the agent reported the course and link.
